column1: # Merrill ordered float frontend on the two retained SPP reference files,
# via the production stages. Columns: name <TAB> columns <TAB> rows
# <TAB> black bits <TAB> gain bits <TAB> spatial <TAB> ApplyGains fnv1a
# <TAB> radial applied <TAB> post-radial fnv1a <TAB> listed records
# <TAB> post-listed fnv1a <TAB> highlight applied <TAB> post-highlight
# fnv1a <TAB> decoded SatMapR marks <TAB> SatMapG marks <TAB> SatMapB
# marks (raw decode, before cleanup; archived inventory values)
# <TAB> despeckle applied <TAB> despeckle records <TAB> post-despeckle
# fnv1a <TAB> offset applied <TAB> offset accepted patches <TAB>
# post-offset fnv1a <TAB> CaptureISO bits.
# Stage 1 is native-oracle verified bit-for-bit; stage 2 is
# instruction-replay verified (the SD1 CAMF omits the shading list, so
# native skips radial for it); stage 3 (listed repair from the camera
# BadPixelsF20 list with the native badness selection) is instruction and
# corpus-inventory verified (record counts match
# followup-float-front/dependencies.json); stage 4 (highlight
# restoration from the camera SatMapR/G/B lists with the native
# ExpEstimate/ExpNet threshold) ports the archived native-oracle kernel
# (followup-native-highlight/check_highlight.cpp, 40-mode stats
# reproduced bit-for-bit by the float_front mode-matrix test) and pins
# the real-file raster hash plus the archived raw mark counts
# (followup-native-highlight/corpus-inputs.json). The SD1 maps are
# present but empty, so its neutralization is the identity (same fnv as
# stage 3). Stage 5 (raster despeckle from the detected speckle list
# with the ApplyGains request gains, the typed DespAdjust default and
# the request strength) ports the archived native oracle
# (followup-despeckle/check_native.cpp; its 7 detector cases, 4
# wrapper cases, LUT endpoints and wheel probes are reproduced by the
# float_front unit tests) and pins the real-file record counts and
# raster hashes. Stage 6 (row/column chroma offset correction from the
# detected speckle pipeline's request gains, CaptureISO and translated
# active rect) ports the archived native-oracle solver and worker
# (followup-offset-svd/solver, followup-repair/croffset/
# check_patch.cpp, followup-offset-svd/scheduling) with the archived
# pinned worker totals reproduced in Rust, and pins the real-file
# accepted-patch counts and raster hashes. The accumulation order is
# the documented deterministic decision (worker 0..=7 outer, patch rows
# and columns ascending); the corpus geometry overlaps, so the hashes
# pin one deterministic member of the native result family, never one
# byte-identical native reference. Sources:
# spp-rgb-trace/followup-float-front-wiring/.
